concerns.text: Descriptor‑Target Correlation Analysis (FR‑014) computes Pearson r and p‑value for each descriptor on the *full* dataset before any train/validation split, making the descriptor relevance assessment dependent on data that will later be used for model training and testing. This creates information leakage and a circular validation of the predictors, violating independence between predictor construction and validation targets.

Statistical Power Analysis (FR‑015) states a target power ≥ 0.8 to detect R² ≥ 0.6 (α = 0.05) but does not specify the required sample size nor demonstrate that the available HEA dataset meets this requirement. Without an explicit sample‑size justification, the power claim is unsupported and the success criterion (SC‑009) lacks a sound empirical basis.
